decision.decision: NO-GO for production typed rectangular-profile-group recovery in this cycle
why: only one unrelated real rectangular-opening positive control was found, and it is a single width/height profile
no unrelated real repeated rectangular profile group with count plus two planar dimensions was found
current profile projection does not identify openings or resolve ambiguity
the contract lacks canonical feature type, face/region, axis, and through/blind semantics for the target
measure_slots has a generic mixed-dimension false-positive that must be isolated before reuse
the candidate would conflate materially different recess, opening, channel, and array semantics
decision.narrow_capability_supported: Volundr already has a limited individual rectangular boundary-profile path; this does not justify a new shared repeated-profile abstraction.
decision.implementation_status: no production extractor, schema, normalizer, verifier, recovery, prompt, CAD, or provider changes

recommended_next_step: Do not implement the proposed profile-group recovery. First isolate and independently correct the generic slot-sample aggregation false positive under a separate Phase 1B cluster, then reassess whether unrelated evidence justifies a small typed rectangular-opening/recess model.
